chapter: Other bands and the Philadelphia years
title: Working with Sidney Desvigne and teaching Ransom Knowling
summary: Zardis worked with Desvigne, found him peculiar, taught his bassist Ransom, and subbed for him on the sand boat and at the Pelican.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yeah I worked with Sidney, I worked with Sidney Desbeam.
But I don't know, I didn't care about working with Sidney. Sidney is a peculiar fellow, you know what I mean? Sidney is a fellow, he uh, I don't know, he just something different attitude from the
He died out in California about four or five years ago. Yeah, I heard that.
I met him out there and I'd never known him here. I did hear him once in time but never talked to him before. I saw him in California.

Yeah. So he had a boy, used to work with him, bass violin, called Ranson. You might have heard of him. Yes I've heard of him. Ranson. He was doubling, he was playing bass fiddle and the horn. Well most of the time that boy would be at my house every day learning what I was learning him, you know what I mean? And I learned him until he got to be a tough man. And he worked out there on that sand boat where I was working at. He worked there a long time with Sidney Desbeam. And I worked in his place several times on that boat and I worked at the country club in Ranson's place where Sidney Desbeam, you know. And right there at the Pelican, Ramport and Gravia. Yeah. Do you remember when you used to give dance up there?
Years ago. Well I worked there a lot of time with Sidney. So like I told you, I played with most of the best bands around this town at that time.
